units.source_text: 这不是特地答复的口气。

en.t: This was not the tone of a deliberate reply.

units.source_text: 少将将此诗传告中将，中将深为感动，说道：“还望你们劝劝她，请她稍稍走出来些。”

en.t: The Lesser Captain passed this poem on to the Middle Captain, who was deeply moved and said, "I hope you will all urge her to come out just a little."

units.source_text: 他对这些侍女也很怨恨。

en.t: He felt very resentful toward these gentlewomen as well.

units.source_text: 少将答道：“我家小姐原是异常冷淡的。”

en.t: The Lesser Captain replied, "My young lady has always been unusually cold."

units.source_text: 她走进里面去一看，浮舟已经逃进她从来不曾窥探过一下的老尼僧房间里去了。

en.t: When she went inside to look, Ukifune had already fled into the old nun's room, a place she herself had never once peered into.

units.source_text: 她不胜惊诧，只得出来向中将如实报告。

en.t: Utterly astonished, she had no choice but to come out and report the truth to the Middle Captain.

units.source_text: 中将说道：“闭居在这山乡里沉思冥想的人，心情定多哀愁。

en.t: The Middle Captain said, "Someone shut away in this mountain village, sunk in thought, must surely have many sorrows in her heart.

units.source_text: 但照大体看来，她并不是不识情趣的人。

en.t: But judging by her nature as a whole, she is not someone without feeling or taste.

units.source_text: 为什么她对我比不识情趣的人更冷淡呢？

en.t: Why, then, is she colder to me than someone who has no feeling at all?

units.source_text: 也许她在恋爱上有过痛苦的经历吧？

en.t: Perhaps she has had some painful experience in love.

units.source_text: 究竟她为什么如此厌世而一直如此消沉？

en.t: Why exactly does she loathe the world so much and remain so deeply depressed?
I hope you will tell me."

units.source_text: 他很想知道底细，恳切地探问。

en.t: He very much wanted to know the truth behind it and questioned her earnestly.

units.source_text: 但少将怎能把真情告诉他呢？

en.t: But how could the Lesser Captain possibly tell him the truth?

units.source_text: 她只答道：“这是我们师父所应该抚养的人。

en.t: She only replied, "This is someone our teacher was meant to care for.

units.source_text: 多年以来疏远了，上次赴初濑进香时忽然相遇，就领了回来。”

en.t: We had been estranged for many years, but when we unexpectedly met during our last pilgrimage to Hatsuse, we brought her back with us."
